messages:
marta: Quick update — CloudWave confirmed marketplace onboarding for the new North-Azura region. They can provision initial capacity but we need to lock SKU entitlement, quota approval, and KMS flow before we go live. Target launch: May 12. Who can take ownership of the entitlement request?

devon: I can own the entitlement request. Need exact vGPU counts + expected QPS for the first 30 days.

nathan (CloudWave): We can commit 8x CW-AZ1-64 machines (NVIDIA A100 equivalent) as an initial pool. Expect ~60k tokens/min peak. SKU to request: CW-AZ1-64. Entitlement doc + quota form: https://cloudwave.example/quotas/submit (private link).

ashley: For Dedicated/Dedicated-Burst mapping, recommend mapping 6 machines to reserved pool + 2 for burst. Also we need to validate KMS connector — CloudWave supports external KMS via standard KML flow, but we need the connector certs.

kai: From infra side — we'll need subnet peering, route table, and a pre-provisioned image. Also, planning note: binpack on AZ-3 in North-Azura is fragile this week; recommend cross-AZ fallback policy.

lee (legal): I'll triage the DPA addendum — we require the data residency appendix and KMS responsibilities. ETA 48-72h after I get the CloudWave security questionnaire filled. Nathan, can you attach the questionnaire answers?

nathan (CloudWave): attaching in thread: answers are uploaded to the quota form. Also adding the connector cert thumbprint: SHA256:AB12...EF34.

partners-bot: ticket PW-912 created for "north-azura marketplace onboarding" and linked to infra-ops ticket INF-3341.

marta: Agenda for Thurs sync 10am PT: 1) SKUs/quotas, 2) KMS cert & connector flow, 3) network peering/infra runbook owner, 4) launch comms/press timing.

devon: I'll open the entitlement request and attach expected traffic numbers by EOD tomorrow.

ashley: I'll draft the Dedicated mapping and the fallback autoscale policy, will throw into INF-3341.

kai: assigning runbook owner — @sre-oncall, can you take the runbook and do a dry-run on Tue?

sre-oncall: Yep, will slot a dry-run Tue 9am PT.

lee (legal): once I have the sec questionnaire, I'll fast-track the addendum. If anything is non-standard, I'll flag it in the doc.

marta: Great — everyone please add any preread to the shared drive: https://redwood.share/north-azura/onboard (do not share publicly). :thumbsup:

nathan (CloudWave): Thanks — excited to get this live. Will join Thurs.

devon: ack.
